title: The four pillars

captions.instagram:
AI, robots, cloud and lasers: the four pillars of BUILT®. Here's how I explain what each technology does in building a home, in plain words.

Plan. Make. Track. Fit.

Save the 4 questions to ask about any build system.

Which pillar would you want explained next?
captions.facebook:
BUILT® rests on four technologies: AI-powered, robotics-driven, cloud-based and laser-guided. I broke down what each one does in building a home.

#ConstructionTech #Housing

Which one sounds most useful to you?
captions.linkedin:
Any build system has to answer four questions: how is it planned, how is it made, how is it tracked, and how precise is the fit?

BUILT® answers each with a technology. In construction generally, AI helps plan layouts and sequence work before anything is built. Robots repeat precise tasks the same way every time. Cloud tools give everyone one live view of a project. Laser measurement guides parts to an exact fit.

That's why we built BUILT® on four pillars: AI-powered, robotics-driven, cloud-based and laser-guided.

#ConstructionTech #Housing

Which question does your industry answer worst?
